recognize_zh: 血液抹片中出現體積大、細胞質嗜鹼性且邊緣有突起的非典型淋巴細胞，染色質細、可見核仁；流式顯示單株輕鏈限制，骨髓切片 IHC 陽性細胞呈間質與竇內分布，符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的白血病性表現。
features: Panels A/B: large atypical lymphoid cells, 2-3 times the size of a small lymphocyte, with moderate to abundant deep basophilic cytoplasm
Irregular, occasionally indented nuclei with finely dispersed to vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli
Irregular cytoplasmic borders with blebs and short projections
Panel C flow cytometry: an abnormal population with light-chain restriction (single light chain) distinct from background leukocytes
Panel D: hypercellular marrow core with an interstitial infiltrate of large cells
Panel E: IHC highlights large neoplastic cells in an interstitial and intrasinusoidal-appearing distribution (marker not labeled)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating large atypical lymphoid cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, irregular cytoplasmic borders, irregular nuclei with dispersed chromatin, and nucleoli. Flow cytometry identifies an abnormal light-chain-restricted population. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with an interstitial infiltrate of large cells, which are highlighted by immunohistochemistry in an interstitial and sinusoidal-appearing distribution. Findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; correlation with splenic imaging and B-cell marker immunophenotype is recommended.

ddx.vs: Blasts have finer chromatin with less cytoplasmic basophilia and express CD34/TdT without surface light-chain restriction.
Prolymphocytes are medium-sized with a single prominent central nucleolus and moderately condensed chromatin, less pleomorphic than these large basophilic cells.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma or hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These are small to medium cells with villous or hairy projections and mature chromatin, not large cells with vesicular nuclei.
Reactive immunoblasts are polyclonal and accompanied by a spectrum of reactive lymphocytes, without light-chain restriction.
